question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)

calls.reasoning: Guidance (rev +9-11% on $102.47B, GM 47-48%, opex $19.1-19.4B, OI&E ~$0.35B, tax ~16.5%) implies net income ~$28.9B, ~$1.97/share on an estimated ~14.7B diluted shares (my estimate, not sourced). Consensus is $1.98-2.00 (range $1.93-$2.15). Apple has beaten in 8 of the last 8 quarters, typically by 3-6%, so the median is ~$2.07. Upside: tariff refunds (+$0.11 last quarter), FX. Downside: supply/memory-cost headwinds, the tail risk of a one-off tax charge (FY24 Q4 was $0.97 on the EU charge). No Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market found.
